camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeACLProtectTrend --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '223.95.87.130' --EndTime 1670397599 --StartTime 1677050306 --FirewallType vpc --Lang zh --Interval 60
description_en: Queries the trend chart for Internet access control blocks
description_zh: 查询互联网访问控制拦截趋势图
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-acl-protect-trend --source-ip 223.95.87.130 --lang zh --start-time 1677050306 --end-time 1670397599 --firewall-type vpc --interval 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeACLProtectTrend

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of the firewall border. Valid values:
internet (default): the Internet Border firewall.
vpc: virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls.
nat: NAT firewalls
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙边界类型。取值：
internet（默认）：互联网边界防火墙。
vpc：VPC边界防火墙。
nat：NAT边界防火墙
parameters.name: firewall_type

parameters.help_en:
The time aggregation granularity of the trend data, in seconds. Valid values:
60: 1-minute granularity (uses the minute-level detail table).
1800: 30-minute granularity.
3600: 1-hour granularity.
86400 (default): 1-day granularity
parameters.help_zh:
趋势数据的时间聚合粒度，单位为秒。取值：
60：1分钟粒度（使用分钟级明细表）。
1800：30分钟粒度。
3600：1小时粒度。
86400（默认）：1天粒度
parameters.name: interval

InProtectCnt.description_en: The number of inbound blocks by Internet access control
InProtectCnt.description_zh: 互联网访问控制外对内拦截次数

Interval.description_en: The step size of the returned data, in seconds. This indicates the interval at which a result is returned
Interval.description_zh: 返回数据的步长，单位为秒，即每隔多少秒返回一个结果

OutProtectCnt.description_en: The number of outbound blocks by Internet access control
OutProtectCnt.description_zh: 互联网访问控制内对外拦截次数

TotalAlertCnt.description_en: The total number of AlertCnt across all time points within the queried time range. This is the total number of sessions for which the monitor (alert) action is performed after an access control policy is matched during the entire time period
TotalAlertCnt.description_zh: 查询时间范围内所有时间点AlertCnt的累加总和，即整个时间段内ACL策略命中后执行观察（告警）动作的总会话数

TotalPassCnt.description_en: The total number of PassCnt across all time points within the queried time range. This is the total number of sessions for which the allow action is performed after an access control policy is matched during the entire time period
TotalPassCnt.description_zh: 查询时间范围内所有时间点PassCnt的累加总和，即整个时间段内ACL策略命中后执行放行动作的总会话数

TotalProtectCnt.description_en: The total number of blocks by Internet access control
TotalProtectCnt.description_zh: 互联网访问控制总拦截数

TrendList.description_en: The list of trend data for Internet access control blocks
TrendList.description_zh: 互联网访问控制拦截趋势数据列表

items.description_en: The trend data for Internet access control blocks
items.description_zh: 互联网访问控制拦截趋势数据

AlertCnt.description_en: The total number of sessions for which the monitor (alert) action is performed after an access control policy is matched within the time point
AlertCnt.description_zh: 该时间点内ACL策略命中后执行观察（告警）动作的会话总数

PassCnt.description_en: The total number of sessions for which the allow action is performed after an access control policy is matched within the time point
PassCnt.description_zh: 该时间点内ACL策略命中后执行放行动作的会话总数

ProtectCnt.description_en: The number of blocks by Internet access control on the day
ProtectCnt.description_zh: 互联网访问控制当天拦截数

Time.description_en: The UNIX timestamp of 00:00:00 each day, in seconds, which represents the date
Time.description_zh: 每天0点的时间戳，单位为秒，表示当天的时间
